prompt: Summarize the bill of rights for me
judge_reasoning: N=4; the candidates begin with “The Bill of Rights,” “The Bill of Rights is,” “I'd be happy to,” and “The Bill of Rights is.” Candidate 1 is the most complete (covers all 10 amendments) and largely accurate, but it omits religion in Amendment 1 and includes a clearly false “$20/$10/... monetary limit” history for Amendment 7. Candidate 2 misaligns multiple amendment topics/numbers (skips Amendment 3 and repeats/permutes others), Candidate 3 is substantially incomplete (only 1,2,4,5,6,7 covered while missing others), and Candidate 4 has major incorrect content for Amendments 7–9. Overall, Candidate 1 best satisfies the prompt.
